title: The Adhan
intro: The adhan announces the prayer time and calls us to pray together.

learn.html: The adhan announces the start of the prayer time and calls people to pray together. The muezzin calls the adhan. When he begins, we stop talking and working and quietly repeat the words of the adhan.

learn.label: Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallaah (2×)
learn.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
learn.en: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah!

learn.label: Ash-hadu anna Muhammadan rasoolullaah (2×)
learn.en: I bear witness that Muhammad is Allah’s Messenger!

learn.label: Allaahu akbar (2×) · Laa ilaaha illallaah
learn.ar: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
learn.tr: Allaahu akbar, Allaahu akbar. Laa ilaaha illallaah.
learn.en: Allah is the Greatest! There is no god but Allah.

learn.title: At Fajr
learn.html: In the Fajr adhan, after Hayya ‘alal-falaah we add twice: As-salaatu khayrun minan-nawm – Prayer is better than sleep.
After the adhan, make the dua: Dua after the Adhan.

options: The call that announces the prayer time

questions.q: What do we do when we hear the adhan?
options: Stop talking and quietly repeat it

questions.q: What is added in the Fajr adhan?
